Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect before my opponent's Digimon unsuspends in the unsuspend phase due to ?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If this Digimon is suspended, return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon's DP to its owner's hand.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon becomes unsuspended during your unsuspend phase, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
